rank.description: The 1-based position the judged chunk held in THAT search — the number that separates "the index is poor" from "the weights are wrong".

400.description: Unknown `searchId` for this project, or a `chunkId` that was not among that search hits — a vote without a rank would be a number without meaning.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
